detail.en: The upper-arm bone receives coracobrachialis and gives origins to brachialis and the lateral and medial heads of triceps. Its epicondyles anchor several forearm muscles [M2].
detail.zh: 肱骨是上臂的骨，承接喙肱肌止点，也是肱肌及肱三头肌外侧头、内侧头的起点。两侧上髁是多块前臂肌肉的起点 [M2]。

summary.en: Turns with the hand during forearm rotation.
summary.zh: 前臂旋转时随手一起转动。

detail.en: The thumb-side forearm bone receives biceps at its tuberosity, pronator teres along its shaft, and brachioradialis near its styloid. It crosses the ulna in pronation [M2].
detail.zh: 拇指侧前臂骨。肱二头肌止于桡骨粗隆，旋前圆肌止于骨干，肱桡肌止于茎突附近。旋前时桡骨交叉到尺骨前面 [M2]。

summary.en: Receives the elbow flexor and extensor tendons.

detail.en: The little-finger-side forearm bone receives brachialis anteriorly and triceps at the olecranon behind the elbow. It remains with the elbow segment while the separate radius turns in the rig [M2].
detail.zh: 小指侧前臂骨。肱肌止于近端前面，肱三头肌止于肘后鹰嘴。骨架中尺骨随肘段活动，而独立的桡骨围绕它转动 [M2]。

summary.en: Shows the wrist and finger attachment landmarks.
summary.zh: 显示腕与手指的附着标志。

detail.en: Carpals, metacarpals and phalanges are merged per side. Wrist tendons reach particular carpals or metacarpal bases; finger tendons reach phalanges or tendon expansions. Palmaris longus reaches soft tissue, so its insertion marker is anchored to its own distal soft-tissue mesh rather than a bone [M2]. No individual finger joint is animated.
detail.zh: 每侧腕骨、掌骨与指骨合为一个网格。腕肌腱止于特定腕骨或掌骨底，指肌腱止于指骨或指背腱膜。掌长肌止于软组织，因此它的止点标记锚定在自身远端软组织网格，而不是骨面 [M2]。模型不驱动单独的指关节。

summary.en: Anchors muscle heads that cross the shoulder.

detail.en: Biceps long head starts above the glenoid, triceps long head below it. Biceps short head and coracobrachialis start at the coracoid process [M2]. The mesh shows these landmarks; the simplified clavicle–scapula chain does not model a full gliding shoulder girdle.
detail.zh: 肱二头肌长头起于关节盂上方，肱三头肌长头起于下方。肱二头肌短头和喙肱肌起于喙突 [M2]。网格保留这些标志；简化的锁骨—肩胛骨链不模拟完整的肩带滑动。

summary.en: Locates the arm muscles on the reference body.
summary.zh: 在参考人体上定位手臂肌肉。

detail.en: The low-detail skin surface comes from the same male reference body as the muscles [M3]. X-RAY reveals the muscles through it.
detail.zh: 低细节皮肤轮廓与肌肉来自同一具男性参考人体 [M3]。透视模式让肌肉从轮廓中显露。
